name: horse_tack
contents: saddle cloth (border; persian = checked border + fringe) + girth, bridle (crownpiece, browband, cheekpieces, noseband), bronze snaffle bit + rings, reins; all skinned to the horse rig; rider_seat marker. NO saddle, NO stirrups
design_source: Parthenon frieze; Attic cavalry vases; Xenophon On Horsemanship; Persepolis reliefs

self_rating.notes: follows trot + gallop; v2 had straps dragged by leg bones (fixed v3: inside-out rays + bone whitelist); persian v3 + gallop not re-rendered after the fix; reins are thin round tubes
